final_ranking: main application scoring (semantic + OKPD2 + experience + win rate + geography + reviews + workload)
known_limitations: Index covers 2000 most active suppliers from the prototype cube.
Prototype embedding profile used only the first 3 OKPD2 codes and first 3 product names.
The final top-5 must therefore be re-ranked by the main application and may be supplemented by database fallback candidates.
